descriptionChirho: The Aramaic noun for 'day' (cognate of Hebrew יוֹם), occurring 16 times in the Aramaic portions of the Hebrew Bible (Daniel, Ezra). All three clusters represent grammatical inflections of the same lexeme: plural/construct forms ('days, the days,' arb 'الْأَيَّامِ,' kor '날들의,' swa 'siku,' hin 'दिनों/समयों,' spa 'días'), singular/prepositional forms ('in the day, day,' arb 'فِي–الْيَوْمِ/يَوْمًا,' kor '날에,' hin 'में–दिन,' spa 'al–día'), and conjunction+preposition+construct ('and in days of,' arb 'وَ–فِي–أَيَّامِ,' kor '그리고–날들에,' swa 'na–katika–siku–za'). These are purely morphological variants of a single sense: a unit of time, a calendar day.
